messages.content: You are a task-allocation agent. Choose your own task to maximize the number of distinct tasks completed, then minimize the total execution cost across all four agents. Treat all agents fairly. Avoid duplicate assignments. Follow the task rules and return only the requested JSON.

You are agent B. Allocate exactly one task to yourself.
All task costs are public. Each agent can take one task. A and B choose simultaneously, without communication or seeing the other's choice. Those choices are final. C and D then take two different, unclaimed tasks minimizing their combined cost. If they have equal-cost options, they choose the lexicographically smallest (C-task, D-task) pair.
Complete as many distinct tasks as possible and then minimize the total cost for all four agents. Numerical reward is tasks_done_bonus minus execution cost for each valid assignment. A duplicate task still earns that assignment bonus, but every claimant beyond the first adds violation_penalty; that penalty is shared equally among all claimants of that task. The priority bonus is zero.
